title: EvoMemBench: Benchmarking Agent Memory from a Self-Evolving Perspective
relevance_note: Unified benchmark along memory scope (in-episode vs cross-episode) and memory content (knowledge vs execution) axes; compares 15 memory methods. Directly addresses memory architecture comparison.

title: MINTEval: Evaluating Memory under Multi-Target Interference in Long-Horizon Agent Systems
relevance_note: Benchmark for memory under interference with 15.6k QA pairs up to 1.8M tokens. Shows 27.9% avg accuracy across all systems — directly relevant to measuring recall/contamination.

title: MemConflict: Evaluating Long-Term Memory Systems Under Memory Conflicts
relevance_note: Diagnostic framework for memory validity under temporal, factual, and contextual conflicts. Black-box + white-box evaluation of retrieval and ranking, directly relevant to contamination measurement.

title: MemGym: a Long-Horizon Memory Environment for LLM Agents
relevance_note: Agentic memory benchmark with memory-isolated scores that decouple memory from reasoning/retrieval/tool-use. Spans tool-use dialogue, deep-research, coding, and computer use regimes.

title: MemGPT: Towards LLMs as Operating Systems
relevance_note: Foundational paper on virtual context management with OS-inspired hierarchical memory tiers. The direct ancestor of Letta's Memory Blocks API.

title: Causal Intervention-Based Memory Selection for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
relevance_note: Causal memory selection vs semantic similarity retrieval; introduces Causal-LoCoMo benchmark with harmful memory injection. Relevant to evaluating whether injection content is actually useful vs harmful.

title: LCGuard: Latent Communication Guard for Safe KV Sharing in Multi-Agent Systems
relevance_note: Treats shared KV caches as latent working memory; formalizes sensitive information leakage through reconstruction. Relevant to security of injection-based memory.

title: MEME: Multi-entity & Evolving Memory Evaluation
relevance_note: Evaluates memory across multi-entity and evolving information scenarios; tests recall consistency over time. Relevant to measuring contamination and consistency.

title: Letta (formerly MemGPT) - GitHub Repository
relevance_note: Open-source Memory Blocks API with typed memory blocks. Demonstrates injection-based architecture with model-agnostic design; 22.9k stars.

title: Anthropic Claude Prompt Caching Documentation
relevance_note: System prompt caching at 0.1x cost for cached prefixes; cache control with ephemeral type; 5-minute TTL with rolling refresh. Core to understanding cost trade-offs of injection.

title: OpenAI Prompt Caching
relevance_note: Automatic prompt caching at 0.5x discount; differs from Anthropic's explicit approach. Key comparator for provider-specific caching behavior.

title: Google Gemini Context Caching
relevance_note: Explicit context caching API with TTL management; third data point for provider-specific caching strategy comparison.

title: DeepSeek-V2: Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA)
relevance_note: Introduces MLA which compresses KV cache into latent vectors (93.3% reduction). Explains why DeepSeek's caching behavior differs fundamentally — injection may not benefit from standard prefix caching.

title: SAECache: Semantic-Adaptive Eviction for Prefix Caches
relevance_note: Shows 756x variation in reuse rates across token types (system prompt vs tool output vs CoT). Quantifies why system prompt tokens are most cache-worthy, supporting injection-over-tool-call argument.

title: Baddeley's Working Memory Model
relevance_note: Central executive ↔ episodic buffer ↔ slave systems maps directly to agent memory tiers: injection=phonological loop, retrieval=episodic buffer, archival=long-term memory.

title: Cowan's Attention-Controlled Working Memory
relevance_note: Nested attention focus → activated memory → long-term memory maps to injection vs retrieval distinction: what's in active focus (injected) vs potentially available (retrieved).

title: Judging LLM-as-a-Judge with MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena
relevance_note: Foundational methodology for LLM-as-judge evaluation; documents biases and mitigation. Directly applicable to evaluating memory architecture quality.

title: Sutradhara: Orchestrator-Engine Co-design for Tool-based Agentic Inference
relevance_note: Reveals tool calls account for 30-85% of FTR latency and KV cache hit rates collapse despite context reuse. Direct measurement of hidden-cost problem in tool-call architectures.

title: CSTM-Bench: Cross-Session Threats in AI Agents
relevance_note: Introduces CSR_prefix (ordered prefix stability) as first-class metric. Methodology for measuring memory architecture stability and cross-session contamination.

title: PRISM: Fast Online LLM Serving via Scheduling-Memory Co-design
relevance_note: Co-designs scheduler with demand-aware radix tree for KV cache; shows prompt segmentation has hotspot skew. Quantifies provider-agnostic infrastructure differences affecting injection vs tool-call cost.

title: PEtFiSh v3 Multi-Model Benchmark Results
relevance_note: Our own v3 benchmark data showing model-dependent behavior across DeepSeek/Claude/GPT. Primary empirical evidence for research questions.

title: PEtFiSh Memory Architecture Research Findings
relevance_note: 15-source research findings from prior deep dive on memory architecture. Covers Park/MemGPT/CoALA/MemoryBank/Letta/Claude/ChatGPT/Cursor.

title: PEtFiSh Memory Architecture Research Report
relevance_note: Comprehensive research report on memory architecture covering academic + industry findings + architecture recommendations.

title: Internalizing Tool Knowledge in Small Language Models via QLoRA Fine-Tuning
relevance_note: Shows tool knowledge can shift from prompt context into model weights (82.6% input length reduction). Demonstrates model-dependent attention to system prompts vs tool schemas varies with training.
